newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on speculative buying.

text.p: Small lot speculative buying boosted CBOT rice futures to a higher close, traders said.
Spread trading was noted with the January/March trading at six to seven cents per cwt, premium March, the traders said.
Prudential Securities was the key buyer of the March and "there were a lot of small orders, a lot of one and two lots traded," a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 250 contracts, below the 462 traded Thursday.
Rice futures closed one to six cents per cwt higher, with January up one at $10.67 per cwt.
